description.zh: 客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。说明 若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId可能不一样。
description.en: Client token, used to ensure the idempotence of the request. Generate a unique value for this parameter from your client to ensure that it is unique across different requests. The ClientToken only supports ASCII characters. Note: If you do not specify this, the system will automatically use the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken identifier. The RequestId may differ for each API request.

description.zh:
路由目标组所在的地域ID。

您可以通过调用[DescribeRegions](~~36063~~)接口获取地域ID。
description.en:
The region ID where the RouteTargetGroup is located.

You can obtain the region ID by calling the [DescribeRegions](~~36063~~) API.
The instance ID of the RouteTargetGroup.

description.zh:
资源的标签键。最多支持输入20个标签键。如需传入该值，则不能输入空字符串。

一个标签键最多支持128个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`。
description.en:
The key of the resource tag. Up to 20 tag keys are supported. If you need to pass this value, you cannot input an empty string.

Each tag key can have up to 128 characters and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. It also cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.

description.zh:
资源的标签值。最多支持输入20个标签值。如需传入该值，可以输入空字符串。

最多支持128个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`。
description.en: The value of the resource tag. Up to 20 tag values are supported. If you need to pass this value, you can input an empty string. A maximum of 128 characters is allowed. The value cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`, and it must not contain `http://` or `https://`.

descriptions.en: Switch Active and Standby For RouteTargetGroup.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun vpc switch-active-route-target --route-target-group-id rtg-xxxx --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --client-token 0c593ea1-3bea-11e9-b96b-88e9fe60000 --tag Value=FinanceJoshua Key=FinanceDept --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun vpc SwitchActiveRouteTarget --region cn-hangzhou --Tag.1.Key FinanceDept --Tag.1.Value FinanceJoshua --RouteTargetGroupId 'rtg-xxxx' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --ClientToken '0c593ea1-3bea-11e9-b96b-88e9fe60000'
